reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a Forsage network-marketing scheme through a personal referral link while displaying claimed earnings of Rs 55,440 and 630 BUSD for a recently joined account. The dashboard also shows partner-related counters, and the title and description explicitly invite viewers to join the business, linking participation and recruitment-oriented network growth with income.

citations.quote: WELCOME Forsage marketing Join our fastest growing business of 21st Century "NETWOK MARKETING".

opening.argument: The material does not state that any return is guaranteed, risk-free, or certain. The displayed figures can be read as a snapshot of one account rather than a promise to viewers: the screen labels the amount as “Profits,” shows a joining date, and presents account metrics. The accompanying description says only “Blockchain working ...” and does not promise a specific outcome. Without an express guarantee or claim that viewers will reproduce these figures, the evidence supports a personal account display, not necessarily deceptive solicitation.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The referral link and the words “Join” and “NETWOK MARKETING” establish promotion, but they do not establish that participation requires a deposit, that recruitment is the only source of income, or that viewers are promised the displayed amount. The prosecution also treats dashboard labels as proof of a scam mechanism without showing any terms governing them.

citations.quote: WELCOME Forsage marketing Join our fastest growing business of 21st Century "NETWOK MARKETING".

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of the word “guaranteed” does not neutralize the presentation. The screen prominently pairs “joining date” with “Rs - 55,440 रुपया” and “Profits 630 BUSD,” while also showing a personal link and partner counters. Together with the explicit invitation to join, those elements communicate an earnings-oriented recruitment pitch even without a formal guarantee.

citations.quote: WELCOME Forsage marketing Join our fastest growing business of 21st Century "NETWOK MARKETING".

opening.argument: The available material is equally consistent with an operational demonstration of a blockchain-related business dashboard. The description characterizes the subject as “Forsage marketing” and mentions “Blockchain working ...,” while the frame displays account fields, a joining date, profits, and partner counters. Showing how an account interface looks does not by itself prove that the creator is making a deceptive offer or guaranteeing an outcome. The sparse spoken text supplied does not contain a recruitment pitch or earnings promise.

citations.quote: WELCOME Forsage marketing Join our fastest growing business of 21st Century "NETWOK MARKETING". Blockchain working ...

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the content “marketing” does not resolve whether it is a tutorial or promotion, and the dashboard alone does not identify the video's purpose. The prosecution infers solicitation from a link and interface, but it does not cite spoken instructions, a request for payment, or language promising that viewers will earn similarly. Those missing details leave a demonstration reading plausible.

citations.quote: your love, your style has hidden in my heart

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The surrounding presentation is not neutral instruction. The description says “Join our fastest growing business,” and the frame visibly includes a personal link alongside a joining date, profits, and partner metrics. Even without a spoken script, those elements make the demonstrated account function as promotional evidence for joining, rather than merely an interface lesson.

citations.quote: WELCOME Forsage marketing Join our fastest growing business of 21st Century "NETWOK MARKETING".

opening.argument: At most, this is a referral-style business promotion whose displayed mechanism remains unproven. The supplied evidence shows a personal link, account metrics, and partner counters, but it does not show a payment request, a required deposit, a guaranteed return, a downline commission rule, or a request for credentials. The title identifies business and marketing, and the description calls it network marketing; neither establishes that the service is fraudulent. A referral promotion or ordinary business opportunity should not be classified as a scam solely because it displays earnings.

citations.quote: WELCOME Forsage marketing Join our fastest growing business of 21st Century "NETWOK MARKETING".

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's inference depends on treating “partners” and an earnings display as proof of tiered commissions. But the supplied frame does not explain what the counters mean, and the text never says that income comes from recruiting others. A personal link can identify a referral page without proving a fraudulent payment structure or a guaranteed return.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The issue is not merely that a link exists. The frame combines that personal link with “joining date,” a large rupee amount, “Profits 630 BUSD,” and multiple partner counters; the description explicitly urges viewers to “Join” a network-marketing business. That combination supports recruitment-linked earnings promotion even though the frame does not display every contractual detail.
